title: Best Cluely Alternative for Interviews — Amigo AI Copilot
description: Looking for a Cluely alternative? Amigo is built specifically for job interviews — resume-aware answers, OS-level stealth, Buddy mode, and pay-as-you-go pricing. Try free, no card.

mainEntity.name: Is Amigo a good Cluely alternative for interviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — and for interviews specifically, Amigo is the stronger fit. Cluely is a general-purpose desktop AI overlay; Amigo is purpose-built for job interviews with resume-aware STAR answers, a Practice Mode, coding interview support, and a Buddy feature for live human help. Amigo is also hidden at the OS process level, which Cluely is not.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Cluely and Amigo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cluely positions itself as an AI assistant for everything — meetings, sales calls, and general desktop work. Amigo focuses entirely on job interviews: it personalizes answers from your resume and job description, structures responses in STAR format, supports live coding platforms, and lets a trusted friend assist you live via Buddy mode.

Cluely's visibility made it the specific target of anti-cheating detection tools, and it is not hidden from Task Manager or Activity Monitor. Amigo is invisible on screen share AND at the OS process level — it doesn't appear in Task Manager, System Monitor, or Activity Monitor.

mainEntity.name: How does Amigo pricing compare to Cluely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cluely charges a monthly subscription. Amigo is pay-as-you-go: from $15 for 2 hours of credits that never expire. If you interview a few times during a job search, you only pay for what you use.

mainEntity.name: Does Amigo support coding interviews like Cluely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Amigo's coding copilot works with HackerRank, LeetCode, CoderPad, and other platforms — it reads your screen and streams hints, time complexity analysis, and working solutions in real time.

mainEntity.name: Can I try Amigo for free before switching from Cluely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Amigo includes 10 minutes of free credits on sign-up with full feature access — no credit card required. Test it in Practice Mode or a real session before deciding.

The gaps

Why people look for an alternative

Cluely is a popular, broad interview-prep copilot — but a few gaps send users looking elsewhere.

General-Purpose, Not Interview-Specialized

Cluely is a broad AI overlay for meetings, sales calls, and everyday desktop work. Interviews are one use case among many — there's no interview-specific preparation flow, practice mode, or STAR answer structuring built around your resume and the job description.

High-Profile Detection Scrutiny

Cluely's publicity made it a target: dedicated anti-Cluely detection tools exist, and it is not hidden from Task Manager or Activity Monitor. The most famous tool in the category is also the most looked-for.

Subscription Pricing

Cluely runs on a monthly subscription. If you only interview during a job search, you keep paying between interviews — or churn and re-subscribe.

The edge

How Amigo pulls ahead

6 places Amigo outperforms Cluely.

Built for Interviews

Not a Generic Overlay

Amigo is purpose-built for job interviews: resume + job description aware answers, STAR structuring, a Practice Mode for full mock interviews, and briefs generated from your own documents.

Deep Stealth Mode

100% Undetectable

Amigo is hidden from screen share, Dock, Taskbar, Task Manager, System Monitor, and Activity Monitor. Cluely is visible in system process lists — and is what detection tools specifically look for.

Buddy Feature

Live Human + AI Support

Invite a trusted friend or mentor via a shareable link. They watch your interview in real time and send AI-assisted tips through your Amigo overlay. Cluely has no human-in-the-loop equivalent.

Under 0.3s Response

Truly Real-Time

Amigo surfaces short, personalized, natural answers the moment your interviewer finishes speaking. No CTRL+ENTER required — just seamless, in-the-moment support.

Coding Interview Copilot

HackerRank, LeetCode, CoderPad

Amigo reads your screen during live coding challenges and provides hints, pseudocode, time complexity analysis, and working solutions in real time.

Pay-As-You-Go Pricing

No Subscription

Amigo uses credits — from $15 for 2 hours, and they never expire. You pay for interviews, not for months on a subscription you forget to cancel.
